notes.title: Fault - Broken Promises is now available to purchase!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/aef86927651024704d2b060e345c9dea56fee2fd.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

We’re overjoyed to announce the official release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924660/Fault__Broken_Promises/]Fault - Broken Promises[/url], developed by Bicorn’s Forest! The game is available right now, with a special 20% off launch discount! Thank you so much for your support, we hope you will enjoy the story of Albel and Aiel!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924660/Fault__Broken_Promises/

After losing in a duel of power and prestige, academy apprentice Albel has to brave the depths of the dungeon to save the beautiful swordswoman Aiel from falling into his rival’s hands. He promised her a future together… Can he keep it, or will their bond get broken?
